open_questions: Depth scatter between sectors (48.84% change, p_constant 0.01285) and within transits (chi2 11.805980124258289 dof 3) likely from spot crossings and low number of transits (4) but higher-precision photometry needed
Rotation period near harmonics (14.8 d is 1.4217886491421983 times ~10.4 d rotation) with strong variability amplitude 9380-11694 ppm, so activity monitoring needed to confirm shape is not activity
RV follow-up to test for bound planetary mass given short 14.8 d period for which stellar companions would show strong phase curve
dossier.public_summary: A flat-bottomed, Earth-to-Neptune-sized dip repeats every 14.8 days on a small M-dwarf with no odd/even alternation, no secondary eclipse and no centroid evidence for a neighbour. The modest depth change between the two sectors and intra-transit scatter are consistent with spotty activity noise rather than a background binary. The planet interpretation is favoured over an eclipsing binary or blend, pending activity and radial-velocity confirmation.

reasons.why: Strongly flat-bottomed (negative v_sigma) favours a planetary transit over a V-shaped grazing EB/blended binary, with fit_b 0.08697 low impact parameter.

No significant odd/even difference (depth_odd 5033 ppm vs depth_even 5690 ppm) and no strong secondary (secondary snr 5.057 only modestly above best_brightening_snr 3.739) disfavour an EB at 14.8 d or 29.6 d.

Planet-sized (rp/rstar 0.0793, undiluted 6289 ppm) from a small M dwarf; TIC and Gaia FLAME radii agree at 0.5608 vs 0.5602 giving the same 4.85 Rearth size and duration ratio 0.6819 consistent with a central transit.

No off-target measurement to favour a neighbour; neighbours plausible_within_1px 0 with could_cause_within_1px 1 requiring 0.2971 eclipse, contratio 0.1517 low, so a neighbour false positive is unlikely.

Depth formally non-constant at p=0.01285 (3655 ppm sector 61 vs 6017 ppm sector 88) but with only 2 sectors and large sector 61 error 870 ppm this is consistent with the transit_depths p_consistent 0.008078222179922765 scatter and is not evidence for a blend; xgboost planet_rank 0.44 supports planet as best explanation.
